mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_file_star_table (star_user_id, star_target_type, star_file_id, star_starred_at) VALUES (#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, 'file', #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{starred_at})

INSERT INTO pcd_file_star_table (star_user_id, star_target_type, star_node_id, star_starred_at) VALUES (#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, 'folder', #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{starred_at})
mapper.select: SELECT s.star_file_id FROM pcd_file_star_table s INNER JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON s.star_file_id = f.file_id WHERE s.star_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND s.star_target_type = 'file' AND f.file_status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ORDER BY s.star_starred_at DESC

SELECT s.star_node_id FROM pcd_file_star_table s INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON s.star_node_id = d.node_id WHERE s.star_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND s.star_target_type = 'folder' AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND c.user_id = d.node_user_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ORDER BY s.star_starred_at DESC

SELECT s.star_id, s.star_user_id, s.star_target_type, s.star_file_id, s.star_node_id, s.star_starred_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS target_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS target_size, f.file_type AS file_type, f.file_status AS file_status FROM pcd_file_star_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON s.star_file_id = f.file_id AND s.star_target_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON s.star_node_id = d.node_id AND s.star_target_type = 'folder' WHERE s.star_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ( ( s.star_target_type = 'file' AND f.file_status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) OR ( s.star_target_type = 'folder' AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND c.user_id = d.node_user_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) ) ORDER BY s.star_starred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_file_star_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON s.star_file_id = f.file_id AND s.star_target_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON s.star_node_id = d.node_id AND s.star_target_type = 'folder' WHERE s.star_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ( ( s.star_target_type = 'file' AND f.file_status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) OR ( s.star_target_type = 'folder' AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND c.user_id = d.node_user_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) )
